Dataset: Agmarknet daily mandi prices (orange, mosambi, lemon)
Why needed (module / model): M2 price forecast; M3 raw material cost; price-trend chart
Key fields to capture: date, state, district, market, commodity, variety, arrivals (t), min/max/modal price (Rs/quintal)
How to collect (steps): 1) Register on data.gov.in and generate an API key. 2) Find the daily mandi price resource and filter state=Maharashtra, commodity=Orange/Mosambi/Lemon. 3) Write a Python script that paginates and stores rows in PostgreSQL. 4) Schedule it daily (cron/APScheduler) and log failures. 5) Keep the raw response for audit.
UI visual it powers: Price trend line; arrivals bars; buying-window calendar
Fallback if unavailable: Manual CSV download from agmarknet.gov.in price reports by date range

Why needed (module / model): M2 needs multi-season history to learn seasonality
Key fields to capture: Same fields as D01, per day, 2015 onward
Source / agency: Agmarknet price reports; Maharashtra State Agricultural Marketing Board (MSAMB)
How to collect (steps): 1) Use Agmarknet report pages to export by commodity, market and date range (small ranges, e.g. monthly). 2) Script the exports or download manually for Nagpur, Katol, Kalmeshwar, Warud. 3) Merge, de-duplicate on (date, market, variety). 4) Plot missing days and decide an imputation rule. 5) Record coverage % per market.
Fallback if unavailable: Request data from MSAMB; or reduce horizon to the years actually available and say so

Key fields to capture: year, country, quantity, value, unit rate
How to collect (steps): 1) Open the APEDA export statistics for fruits. 2) Filter for oranges/citrus/mandarins. 3) Download and copy into a clean year-country table.
UI visual it powers: Export demand mini-chart on Business Models
Fallback if unavailable: Use headline export figures from APEDA reports and cite them

Dataset: Processed-product price benchmarks (juice, squash, peel oil, bio-products)
Why needed (module / model): M3 revenue assumptions; margin ranges on Business Models
Key fields to capture: product, pack size, wholesale price, retail price, source, date
Source / agency: Wholesale marketplaces, brand sites, trade quotes
How to collect (steps): 1) List 8-10 target products. 2) Record 3+ prices per product from different sources, with date. 3) Convert to Rs/kg or Rs/litre. 4) Store min/median/max.
Fallback if unavailable: Use ranges from CCRI/NABARD project reports and mark as 'reference'

Dataset: Tehsil-wise citrus area, production and yield
Why needed (module / model): M1 ranking by local raw-material availability; choropleth map
Key fields to capture: district, tehsil, year, area (ha), production (t), yield (t/ha)
Source / agency: Maharashtra Agriculture Dept; NHB/MIDH area & production; ICAR-CCRI
Where to look: Dept. of Agriculture Maharashtra statistics; NHB 'Horticulture statistics'; CCRI reports
How to collect (steps): 1) Collect district-level tables from NHB/state agri statistics. 2) For tehsil level, request/obtain tables from the District Superintending Agriculture Officer (Nagpur) or CCRI. 3) Extract PDF tables with Camelot/pdfplumber. 4) Clean tehsil names to one spelling list. 5) Where only district data exists, allocate to tehsils using orchard share and label it 'estimated'.
Fallback if unavailable: District data + CCRI cluster statements, labelled 'estimated'

Dataset: Orchard tree count and age profile
Key fields to capture: tehsil, trees, bearing vs non-bearing, age band
How to collect (steps): 1) Search CCRI reports for orchard census numbers. 2) Visit/email the district agriculture office with a formal request letter from college. 3) Enter figures into a table with source and year.
Fallback if unavailable: Derive from area x standard trees/acre (e.g. 120/acre) and label as estimate

Dataset: Bahar season calendar and harvest windows
Why needed (module / model): M2 seasonality; buying-window calendar; M3 working-capital timing
Key fields to capture: bahar (Ambia/Mrig/Hasta), flowering month, harvest start/end, peak month
How to collect (steps): 1) Read CCRI bulletins on bahar treatment. 2) Record months for each bahar. 3) Validate with 2 orchard owners during interviews.

Dataset: Post-harvest loss and processing recovery rates
Why needed (module / model): M3 yield/loss assumptions; M5 knowledge base
Key fields to capture: loss % by stage, juice recovery %, peel oil yield, by-product yields
How to collect (steps): 1) Search 'citrus post-harvest loss India', 'orange juice recovery %'. 2) Record value, source, year and conditions. 3) Store a low/base/high value for each parameter.
Fallback if unavailable: Use the ranges quoted in NABARD/MoFPI project reports

Key fields to capture: tehsil, dominant soil, pH range, land-use class
How to collect (steps): 1) Download soil/land-use layers for Nagpur. 2) Clip to tehsils in QGIS. 3) Export tehsil-level summary as CSV.

Key fields to capture: date, district/grid, rainfall (mm), Tmax, Tmin
How to collect (steps): 1) Download gridded rainfall/temperature for 2015-present. 2) Extract grid points inside Nagpur district using Python (xarray). 3) Aggregate to monthly per tehsil.
Fallback if unavailable: Monthly district normals from IMD reports

Dataset: Groundwater depth and stage of extraction
Why needed (module / model): Water-source suitability for orchards/processing; drip planning
Key fields to capture: block, pre/post-monsoon depth (m), extraction stage, category
How to collect (steps): 1) Download the Nagpur district groundwater report/dynamic resources. 2) Extract block table. 3) Map block names to tehsils.

Why needed (module / model): Risk score in ranking; map layer
Key fields to capture: tehsil, rainfall deficit %, hot days, groundwater depth, index 0-100
Source / agency: Derived from rainfall, temperature and groundwater
How to collect (steps): 1) Normalise rainfall deficit, heat days and groundwater depth to 0-1. 2) Combine with documented weights. 3) Store formula and weights in the repo.

Key fields to capture: tehsil name, code, geometry
How to collect (steps): 1) Download India sub-district boundaries. 2) Filter to Nagpur district. 3) Simplify geometry (mapshaper/QGIS) for web. 4) Standardise tehsil names to the list used elsewhere.

Dataset: MIDC industrial areas and food parks
Key fields to capture: name, location, lat/lon, area (acre), plot availability, contact
How to collect (steps): 1) List MIDC estates in Nagpur region (Butibori, Hingna, MIHAN, Kalmeshwar, Mohpa, Ramtek, Narkhed...). 2) Get location from MIDC site/Google Maps. 3) Record coordinates and available facilities.

Dataset: APMC yards and mandis (location and facilities)
Key fields to capture: name, tehsil, lat/lon, market days, commodities, facilities
How to collect (steps): 1) Create a list of APMCs from MSAMB. 2) Geocode each. 3) Record market days and facilities (auction hall, storage).

Dataset: Cold storages, pack-houses, grading and waxing units
Why needed (module / model): Infrastructure availability; gap analysis for new units
Key fields to capture: name, type, capacity (MT), lat/lon, owner, contact
Source / agency: NHB cold-storage list; MIDH; MSAMB; OSM; Google Places
How to collect (steps): 1) Download NHB cold-storage directory for Maharashtra. 2) Query Places/OSM for 'cold storage', 'pack house', 'fruit processing' around Nagpur. 3) De-duplicate by name+coordinates. 4) Verify 10-15 by phone or site visit.

Key fields to capture: name, product, scale, location, FSSAI no.
Source / agency: FSSAI license search, Udyam registry, Google Places, IndiaMART
How to collect (steps): 1) Search FSSAI public register by district/product where permitted. 2) Add units from Places. 3) Classify by scale. 4) Store counts per tehsil.

Dataset: Road network and travel distances/time (to mandi, MIDC, airport, rail)
Why needed (module / model): Distance features in M1; map routing
Key fields to capture: origin, destination, km, minutes
How to collect (steps): 1) Build a table of tehsil centroids and key sites. 2) Use OSRM/Google Directions to compute km and minutes. 3) Cache results.

Key fields to capture: category, Rs/kWh, fixed charge, load shedding notes
How to collect (steps): 1) Download the current MSEDCL tariff order. 2) Record LT/HT industrial and agri rates. 3) Note effective date.
Fallback if unavailable: Use rates quoted in project reports

Key fields to capture: name, location, courses, duration, fee, contact
Source / agency: ICAR KVK network, ICAR-CCRI, MCED, EDII
How to collect (steps): 1) List KVKs in/near Nagpur. 2) Record relevant courses and duration. 3) Map each course to a skill in your skills table.

Dataset: PMFME guidelines, unit cost norms and subsidy caps
Key fields to capture: scheme, eligibility, subsidy %, cap, margin money, ODOP rules, document list
How to collect (steps): 1) Download the latest PMFME guidelines. 2) Convert each rule into a row: condition, threshold, outcome, clause number. 3) Have a second person review the rule table. 4) Record the guideline version/date.

Dataset: MIDH / NHB cost norms and subsidy patterns
Key fields to capture: component (cold store, pack-house, nursery...), unit cost, subsidy %, cap
How to collect (steps): 1) Download MIDH common guidelines and cost norms. 2) Extract unit cost and subsidy % per component. 3) Record version/date.

Dataset: NABARD / AIF / CGTMSE / Mudra loan terms
Key fields to capture: scheme, interest rate or spread, tenure, moratorium, margin %, collateral
How to collect (steps): 1) Record terms from each scheme's official page. 2) Add 2-3 bank offers (SBI, Bank of Maharashtra) as examples. 3) Store date and source.

Key fields to capture: scheme, eligible activity, subsidy, cap, applicant category
How to collect (steps): 1) List relevant state/central schemes. 2) Capture eligibility and subsidy per scheme. 3) Add to the same rule table as PMFME.

Key fields to capture: RBI repo rate, typical agri-loan rate, date
How to collect (steps): 1) Record the RBI repo rate and 3-4 bank agri/MSME rates monthly. 2) Store with date.

Dataset: Equipment and machinery costs (grader, extractor, pasteuriser, cold room, packing)
Key fields to capture: equipment, capacity, price (Rs), vendor, quote date, GST
How to collect (steps): 1) List 12-15 equipment items per business model. 2) Get 3 quotes (call/email/catalogue) per item. 3) Store low/median/high with date. 4) Keep screenshots/quotes as proof.

Key fields to capture: licence, authority, fee, processing time, documents
How to collect (steps): 1) List licences per business type. 2) Record fee, validity and documents from official pages. 3) Link each to the roadmap tasks.

Why needed (module / model): M3 calibration; sanity check of outputs
Key fields to capture: project, capacity, capex, working capital, revenue, margin, IRR, DSCR
Source / agency: NABARD model projects, MoFPI, NHB, CCRI
How to collect (steps): 1) Download 8-10 model projects close to your business models. 2) Record capex, revenue, margins, IRR, DSCR. 3) Use as test cases: your engine's output should be in a similar range.

Key fields to capture: skill level, Rs/day, source, year
How to collect (steps): 1) Download latest minimum wage notification. 2) Record unskilled/semi-skilled/skilled daily rates.

Why needed (module / model): Problem context; unemployment framing; tehsil profile
Key fields to capture: population, rural %, workforce, unemployment rate
How to collect (steps): 1) Download tehsil tables from Census (PCA) for Nagpur. 2) Add the latest PLFS state/district indicators. 3) Build a tehsil profile table.

Dataset: Processed citrus market size and competition
Key fields to capture: market size, growth, key players, source
How to collect (steps): 1) Search for citrus processing market reports. 2) Record headline numbers and source. 3) Use only as supporting context.

Dataset: Synthetic entrepreneur personas (for testing and demos)
Key fields to capture: capital, land, water, skills, location, risk, time, intent
How to collect (steps): 1) Define 10-15 personas from interview patterns (e.g. 'student, Rs 3L, no land'). 2) Write the inputs for each. 3) Run the ranker and keep outputs for demo and testing.

Key fields to capture: persona, expert, ranked list, rationale
Source / agency: Interviews with KVK/CCRI experts, bankers, entrepreneurs
How to collect (steps): 1) Prepare 5-6 persona cards. 2) Ask each expert to rank the top 3 business models. 3) Record rank and rationale. 4) Compute agreement (Spearman/top-3 overlap) with the system.

Key fields to capture: name (alias), role, offers, looking for, location, consent
Source / agency: Real volunteers (with consent) or clearly labelled mock
How to collect (steps): 1) Ask 5-8 volunteers to share offers/needs with consent. 2) Anonymise names. 3) Fill remaining profiles as mock and label them 'demo data'.

Why needed (module / model): M5 advisory chatbot and DPR generation
Key fields to capture: document, section, text chunk, source, page, version
Source / agency: CCRI manuals, PMFME/MIDH/NABARD guidelines, FSSAI/MPCB norms
How to collect (steps): 1) Collect 15-25 official PDFs. 2) Extract text (pdfplumber) and clean headers/footers. 3) Chunk by section with page number and source. 4) Embed into a vector store. 5) Keep the version/date of each PDF.
